newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas, Asiana to codeshare flights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas, Asiana to codeshare flights.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed a codeshare agreement with the unlisted Asiana Airlines of South Korea covering the majority of the services they each operate between Australia and Seoul, South Korea.

Qantas, 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc, said it will put its QF on Asiana's four weekly return flights, two of which link Seoul with the tropical Queensland city of Cairns and the other two which operate between Seoul and Sydney.
It said Asiana will place its code OZ on all services operated by Qantas between Seoul and Cairns and between Seoul and Sydney.
Qantas said it and Asiana will offer six non-stop services between Sydney and Seoul each week and five flights in the opposite direction.
The arrangement will include non-stop flights by Qantas and Asiana between Seoul and Cairns in north Queensland, it said.

The codeshare, scheduled for implementation in mid November subject to government approval - is designed to provide greater choices for customers of both airlines flying between Australia and Korea, Qantas said.
